name: Valorant Tracker
author: PackRat
short_description: Turn Stream Deck into a physical VALORANT ranked dashboard for RR, session progress, recent competitive stats, agents, maps and match controls.
description: Valorant Tracker puts the ranked information you actually check during a competitive session directly on Stream Deck. See your current rank and RR, track session wins, losses and net RR, review recent performance, expand agent and map stats on larger decks, and keep useful match controls such as a 45 second spike timer under your hand. Account setup is shared across every key, so you enter your Riot ID, region and HenrikDev API key once. The plugin uses one shared cache and refresh service rather than making duplicate requests for every visible key. Bundled dashboards are included for standard Stream Deck, Stream Deck XL and Stream Deck Neo and can be customized after installation.
highlights: Current competitive rank, RR and latest RR movement
Persistent session RR plus win and loss record
Recent headshot percentage, damage and ACS
Top agent K/D and win rate with expandable slots
Top map win rate with expandable slots
Recent match views for larger dashboards
Manual win and loss controls with later API reconciliation
Bundled Standard, XL and Neo dashboard profiles
One shared account setup for every action
Five minute shared cache with last known good fallback
requirements: Windows 10 or newer, or macOS 12 or newer
A Riot ID in Name#TAG format
A user provided HenrikDev API key
setup_summary: Install Valorant Tracker and open any action's Property Inspector
Enter Riot ID as Name#TAG and choose region
Open the HenrikDev dashboard, generate an API key and paste it once
Use the bundled dashboard for your Stream Deck model or arrange individual actions yourself
privacy: Riot ID, region, HenrikDev API key, session state and cached player data are stored using Stream Deck settings on the user's computer. PackRat does not receive the API key or player data. Requests required for player statistics are sent to HenrikDev.
third_party: Requires a user provided HenrikDev API key. HenrikDev is an independent third party community API. Availability, endpoint behavior and rate limits are outside PackRat's control.
